title: oncemore project
description: Input file for the oncemore DVD-Video authoring tool (project.oncemore.json).

playlists.description: Sequences of titles and chapter ranges, started by playlist:<id> buttons.

rotate.description: Degrees the object is turned clockwise about its centre (Object > Rotate, the Rotate tool). Default 0. On a button: its label or picture and its highlight, not its thumbnail.

flip.description: The object mirrored left-right, top-bottom or both (Object > Flip), before it is rotated.

id.description: Identifier used in actions, e.g. title:t1 or menu:main.

prohibit.description: next / prev (chapter skip), fast_forward / rewind, pause, stop, search (number keys: title, chapter and time search), menu (Menu / Pop-up key), title (Title / Top Menu key), audio, subtitle (stream change). On a DVD: the program chain's prohibited user operations; on a Blu-ray: the playlist's UO mask.

bitrate.description: Bits per second as an integer, or a string such as "192k" or "5.5M".

action.description: menu:<id> | menu:<id>:<button id> (that menu with the button highlighted) | title:<id> | chapter:<title id>:<n> (1-based) | playall | playlist:<id> | audio:<n> | subtitle:<n> | subtitle:off | page:next | page:prev | page:<n> (buttons of a menu with pages: that page of the same menu) | resume | stop. playall plays every title in project order, then follows the last title's end_action. resume (menu buttons only) continues the title the remote's Menu / Title key interrupted, or plays the first title when there is nothing to resume.

label.description: ISO volume label. Normalised to A-Z 0-9 _ and at most 32 characters.

layer_break.description: DVD9: where the disc goes on to its second layer. auto (the first chapter past the middle of the disc) or <title id>:<chapter>.

first_play.description: menu:<id> | title:<id> | playall | playlist:<id>. What starts when the disc is inserted. Default: first menu, or first title if there are no menus.

title_key.description: What the remote's Title / Top Menu key opens: menu:<id> | title:<id> | playall | playlist:<id>. Default: the first menu.

font.description: Font file for menu text. null = auto-detect (Hiragino on macOS, then Noto Sans CJK, then DejaVu Sans).

video_bitrate.description: "auto" (fit the disc, default) or a fixed average video bitrate.

subtitle_style.description: Look of burned subtitle bitmaps (all subtitle tracks).

margin.description: Distance of the last line from the bottom.

rom_files.description: Files or folders copied to the root of the disc next to VIDEO_TS (DVD-ROM content for computers).

bluray.description: Settings used when the project is built as a Blu-ray.

target.description: Disc size: single layer (25 GB) or dual layer (50 GB).

id.description: Menu id. Default: chapters_<title id>. Extra pages get _2, _3, ...

title.description: Heading text. Default: the title name.

back.description: Action of the BACK button. Default: the first menu.

label_format.description: Label under each thumbnail; {n} is the chapter number. Default: "Chapter {n}".

background_video.description: Motion background for the chapter menu.

animated_thumbnails.description: With background_video: the thumbnails play the chapter instead of a still frame.

source.description: Video file, relative to the project file.

slideshow.description: Make this title from pictures instead of a video file.

clips.description: Make this title from several videos and still pictures played one after another (videos optionally trimmed), instead of one source. Every clip starts a chapter unless chapters are given.

source.description: Video file or still picture (.png, .jpg, .jpeg, .bmp, .tif, .tiff, .webp), relative to the project file.

in.description: Start inside the video file (default: its beginning). Not for pictures.

out.description: End inside the video file (default: its end). Not for pictures.

duration.description: A still picture: how long it is shown, 0.5 s to 1 hour (default 5 s).

fit.description: A still picture of another shape than the frame: fit shows all of it with black bars around; fill fills the frame and crops what is outside.

name.description: Shown on the chapter menu instead of "Chapter n".

poster.description: Time (in the title) of the chapter menu thumbnail.

chapters.description: Chapter start times, or {time, name, poster} objects. 0 is added automatically if missing.

codec.description: ac3 and lpcm are encoded (or AC-3 copied, passthrough); dts is always copied from the sources (48 kHz DTS; a DTS-HD source gives its DTS core).

bitrate.description: AC-3 only. Default 192k (448k for 5.1). DTS keeps the source's own rate.

channels.description: 2 = stereo (sources are down-mixed), 6 = 5.1 (AC-3 or DTS). Default 2 (DTS: 6); copied sound must match its source.

passthrough.description: Copy AC-3 audio (48 kHz, from the sources) onto the disc unchanged instead of re-encoding it.

end_action.description: menu:<id> | title:<id> | chapter:<title id>:<n> | playall | playlist:<id> | lastmenu | stop. lastmenu returns to the menu shown last. Default: first menu, or stop.

remote_menu.description: Menu opened by the remote's Menu key during this title. Default: the first menu.

prohibit.description: Remote keys that do nothing during this title (user operations), e.g. a notice that cannot be skipped: ["next", "fast_forward", "menu"].

auto_chapter_menu.description: Generate a chapter-selection menu with thumbnails for this title.

audio_tracks.description: Audio streams of this title (replaces the single default track). codec/bitrate come from `audio`.

source.description: File to take the audio from. Default: the title source.

stream.description: Index among that file's audio streams. Default 0.

captions.description: Closed captions (line 21, CEA-608) on an NTSC DVD: a Scenarist .scc file used as it is, or a subtitle file (SubRip, WebVTT, ASS, text script) sent as pop-on captions. A file, or {file, offset} with offset taken off every time (seconds, "HH:MM:SS" or a timecode such as "01;00;00;00").

file.description: Subtitle file: SubRip (.srt), WebVTT (.vtt), ASS / SSA (.ass, .ssa), or a text script (.txt: number, start and end timecode, text).

offset.description: Subtracted from every subtitle's time: the start of the source's own timecode the file was timed against (seconds, "HH:MM:SS[.mmm]", or a timecode such as "01;00;00;00"). Default 0.

default.description: Show this track when the title starts.

position.description: Where the lines go (cues can override with {\an8} / line:0 / ASS alignment).

color.description: Text colour of this track (default: disc.subtitle_style.color); cues can override it.

aspect.description: Display aspect of this title (default: disc.aspect). Titles with a different aspect or audio codec go into their own DVD titleset automatically.

video_bitrate.description: This title's own average video bitrate (1-8 Mbit/s); the other titles share what is left on the disc.

picture.description: A still picture shown for the whole title when its source is sound only (music); without it the screen is black.

transcode.description: false: the source is already DVD video (MPEG-2 at the disc's frame size and rate, at most 9.8 Mbit/s) and its picture is used as it is, not encoded again (DVD only; the sound is still made to the title's audio settings).

scan.description: How the picture is stored. auto: interlaced sources at the disc's frame rate and 50p / 59.94p sources stay interlaced (every field kept), 23.976p film on NTSC gets soft 3:2 pulldown, everything else is progressive. progressive: deinterlace and convert the frame rate. interlaced / pulldown force that mode. ivtc: film that was telecined to 29.97i (NTSC); its film frames are recovered (inverse telecine) and stored with soft 3:2 pulldown.

hidden.description: Switched off in the Layers panel: not on the disc.

page.description: Menus with pages: the page it is on. Without it, it is on every page.

text.description: One line, or a paragraph: lines separated by newlines.

align.description: How the lines of a paragraph line up (x is the paragraph's left edge).

line_spacing.description: Pixels added between the lines of a paragraph.

font.description: Font file for this element (default: the disc font). It must contain every character.

shadow.description: Drop shadow colour (#RRGGBBAA for a soft one).

bold.description: Drawn with the bold face of its font's family (the family must have one).

italic.description: Drawn with the italic face of its font's family (the family must have one).

kerning.description: Use the font's kerning pairs (false: every character at its own advance).

hidden.description: Switched off in the Layers panel: not on the disc.

page.description: Menus with pages: the page it is on. Without it, it is on every page.

label.description: Text of the button. Optional for image buttons (then only shown in the editor).

image.description: Image button: a picture (PNG with transparency works best) drawn at x/y instead of the label.

width.description: Image buttons: width in menu pixels (720-wide grid); the height follows the picture's aspect. Default: the picture's own width.

highlight.description: Image buttons: a frame around the picture, or its shape (opaque pixels) in the highlight colour.

x.description: Left edge of the label or image, in menu pixels (720 wide).

y.description: Top edge of the label or image (480 high for NTSC, 576 for PAL).

auto_activate.description: Run the action as soon as the button is selected (no Enter needed).

audio.description: Audio stream (1-based) to switch to when the button is used, along with its action (e.g. play the film with the commentary).

subtitle.description: Subtitle stream (1-based) to show when the button is used, along with its action; 0 = subtitles off.

override.description: End action override: when the title this button plays (title:... / chapter:... action) ends, go here instead of the title's own end_action. Only for plays started from this button.

transition.description: Link transition: a short video played when the button is pressed, before its link (a menu, title, chapter, playlist or play all), e.g. the menu dissolving into the next one.

font.description: Font file for this element (default: the disc font). It must contain every character.

shadow.description: Drop shadow colour (#RRGGBBAA for a soft one).

bold.description: Drawn with the bold face of its font's family (the family must have one).

italic.description: Drawn with the italic face of its font's family (the family must have one).

kerning.description: Use the font's kerning pairs (false: every character at its own advance).

highlight_image.description: A picture whose opaque pixels are this button's highlight, placed at x/y (sized like the image button, or at its own size scaled to the 720-wide grid with `width`). Without label and image the button is just this highlight over the background (e.g. imported from a layered Photoshop file).

thumbnail.description: A picture of the button's title / chapter (its action must be title:... or chapter:...), drawn into this rectangle of the menu.

time.description: Frame to show (default: one second into the chapter).

animated.description: Play the chapter in a motion menu.

pages.description: How many pages the menu has (Menu > Add New Page). Its texts, buttons, rectangles and pictures with a page are on that page only; the rest are on every page. Buttons go to another page with page:next, page:prev or page:<n>, and menu:<id>:<button> opens the page that holds the button. On the disc each page is a menu of its own.

background.description: Still image (PNG/JPEG...). Scaled to fit the disc aspect.

psd.description: The layered Photoshop file this menu was imported from (kept so it can be imported again after editing).

background_color.description: Used when background is null, and for letterbox bars.

duration.description: Loop length in seconds. Default 5, or the music length.

loop.description: How many times the menu plays before its end_action: "forever" (default) or a count.

loop_point.description: Where each repeat starts (motion menus / music): the part before it plays once, as an intro. Default 0.

buttons_at_loop.description: The buttons appear (and work) only from loop_point on, so the intro before it plays out. Default false.

prohibit.description: Remote keys that do nothing while this menu shows (user operations).

button_offset.description: Added to the buttons' numbers for the remote's number keys: with 10, the first button is selected with 11 (to match chapter numbers, say). Default 0.

vertical.description: X positions (pixels from the left, on the 720-wide grid).

guides.description: Guides for placing objects in the menu editor (View > New Guide). Kept with the menu, never on the disc.

fade_in.description: Seconds the menu fades in from black (picture and sound) when it starts, at most 10. It plays once: repeats start at the end of the fade, or at loop_point if that is later. Default 0 (none).

end_action.description: What happens after the last loop (only with a loop count). Default: stop.

default_button.description: Button highlighted when the menu opens. Default: the first.

remember_button.description: Coming back to this menu highlights the button used last (menus 1-7). Default true.

shapes.description: Filled rectangles drawn under the texts and buttons (bars, panels).

images.description: Pictures placed on the menu that are not buttons (logos, photos), drawn over the rectangles and under the texts and buttons.

background_video.description: Video file for a motion menu (takes precedence over background). Its own audio is used when `audio` is not set.

lang.description: ISO 639-1 language code, e.g. en, ja.

end_action.description: After the last item: menu:<id> | title:<id> | chapter:<title id>:<n> | playall | playlist:<id> | lastmenu (the menu shown last) | stop. Default: stop.

order.description: The order the items play in: as listed, random (as many items as the playlist has, each picked at random, so one can come more than once) or shuffle (each once, in a random order). Random and shuffle are for Blu-ray and the web version; a DVD plays the items as listed.

hidden.description: Switched off in the Layers panel: not on the disc.

page.description: Menus with pages: the page it is on. Without it, it is on every page.

hidden.description: Switched off in the Layers panel: not on the disc.

page.description: Menus with pages: the page it is on. Without it, it is on every page.

slides.description: The pictures, up to 999, each a chapter. A DVD title has at most 99 chapters, so on a DVD the pictures after the 98th are part of chapter 99 (and a slideshow advanced by hand has at most 99 pictures there).

fit.description: This picture's own fit (default: the slideshow's).

transition.description: The change from this picture to the next (default: the slideshow's).
Between the pictures: a cross-fade, a dissolve, through black or white, a wipe, slide, circle, radial sweep or pixelation; random picks one for each change (the same every build); none cuts.

pan_zoom.description: A slow zoom in / out on every picture.

fit.description: Pictures of another shape than the frame: fit shows all of each with the background colour around; fill fills the frame and crops what is outside.

audio.description: Music: one file, or several played one after another; cut to the slideshow's length and faded out.

advance.description: manual: every picture stays on screen until the viewer presses Next or Play (a still on the disc); the pictures change with cuts, and there is no music.

fit_to_audio.description: Stretch or shorten the pictures' durations (in proportion) so the slideshow is exactly as long as its music.

background_color.description: Around pictures of another shape. Default black.
